preconditions.description: The number of packets n is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each packet contains between 1 and 1000 balloons inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (1 <= k <= n and len(indices) == k and set(indices).issubset(set(range(1, n+1))) and len(set(indices)) == k and sum(a[i-1] for i in indices) != sum(a[j-1] for j in set(range(1, n+1)) - set(indices)))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating impossibility, or a valid division of packets where Grigory and Andrew each get at least one packet and the total number of balloons in their packets is not equal.
